⚠ Full Admin Features

Add/edit/delete rooms, upload photos, manage gallery, and change hero images require the Node.js server. To enable:

  1. Install Node.js from nodejs.org
  2. Run cd server && npm install && npm run dev
  3. Run cd admin && npm install && npm run dev
  4. Open http://localhost:5173
